name: @uipkge/registry-monorepo
description: UIPKGE open-source dual-framework component registry (Vue & React).

scripts.build:registry: bun --cwd packages/vue build && bun --cwd packages/react build
scripts.test: bun --cwd packages/vue test && bun --cwd packages/react test
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd packages/vue typecheck && bun --cwd packages/react typecheck
scripts.verify: bun run verify:vue && bun run verify:react
